module_summary: fntsys.cpp is the FreeType font system (one FontSystem instance behind the C-style fnt* API): a trimmed FreeType module list, per-font glyph cache pages and GS atlases, one semaphore plus a GUI-lock frame scope against the IO worker, weight/embolden support, string drawing and measuring (txtShape for Arabic/Hebrew in normal builds, an older bidi path under __RTL), and three text-fitting helpers (fntRenderStringFit, fntWrapText, fntFitString). grid.h/grid.cpp implement the Grid cover view (page layout and navigation arithmetic inline in the header, page slide, case flip with a COV2 back-cover cache, vignette, selection frame, device sidebar). plasma.h/plasma.cpp are the animated perlin-noise menu background (VU0 mix, 32x32 texture refreshed 6 rows per frame). psbbnflow.h/psbbnflow.cpp draw the PSBBN Game Collection view on top of the Coverflow element. renderman.h is the renderer API used by every drawing module (alignment and scaling constants, quad types, draw and screen-scaling functions).

reusable_helpers.name: fntRenderStringFit
reusable_helpers.what: draws a string clipped to a width: whole, marquee-scrolled, or cut to end in '...', UTF-8 safe, binary-search measuring

reusable_helpers.name: fntWrapText
reusable_helpers.what: greedy word wrap into an output buffer with hard newlines, over-wide word breaking and CJK/Thai/Lao break rules; returns line count

reusable_helpers.name: fntFitString
reusable_helpers.what: in-place word wrap that replaces spaces with newlines to fit a width

reusable_helpers.name: fntScaleFontSize
reusable_helpers.what: maps the default font size to the Small/Default/Large menu font setting

reusable_helpers.name: gridKeyInt
reusable_helpers.what: reads the theme config int key '<name>_<suffix>' with a default

reusable_helpers.name: gridSlideEase
reusable_helpers.what: clamped cubic ease-out 0..1 for slide animations

reusable_helpers.name: gridClamp
reusable_helpers.what: clamps rows/columns to defaults, maxima and a cell budget

reusable_helpers.name: psbbnFlowRoundRect
reusable_helpers.what: outline points of a rounded rectangle (4 steps per corner) for triangle fans

reusable_helpers.name: psbbnFlowCrop
reusable_helpers.what: texel UV window that centre-crops an image to a square

reusable_helpers.name: PlasmaBackground::ease
reusable_helpers.what: table-driven quintic smoothstep 0..1, also used for screen transitions

findings.title: Second renderString body and bidi helpers under __RTL are superseded by txtShape, which already lays out Hebrew/Arabic in every build
findings.problem: The extras/extras_ds5 configurations define __RTL (build_configuration.py:38), which swaps in a 154-line second copy of renderString (its first 30 lines repeat 710-740) plus isRTL/isWeak/renderSubRTL, and turns OFF txtShape in drawing and measuring. txtShape (textshape.cpp:283-287, 381) already reorders right-to-left lines for U+0590..08FF, i.e. Hebrew and Arabic, and also joins Arabic letters, so the __RTL build keeps a cruder duplicate bidi path; isRTL repeats txtRtlChar's ranges.
findings.fix: Delete the #else __RTL branch (isRTL, isWeak, renderSubRTL and the second renderString), the #ifndef __RTL/#endif lines at 709 and 1217/1223, the renderSubRTL declaration, and the RTL tag in the About box; drop __RTL from the extras configuration. Update the source-text assertion in .github/scripts/test_ripps2_text_port.py:72.
findings.benefit: ~160 source lines removed; the extras build gets the same (better) RTL layout as standard builds and one drawing path to maintain. ELF size of the extras build shrinks by the RTL code (INFERRED, not measured).
findings.evidence: Read fntsys.cpp:709-962,1211-1258 and fontsystem.h:116-118. Grep __RTL over the repo: Makefile:228 (legacy), tools/build_configuration.py:38 (extras, extras_ds5), fontsystem.h:116, gui.cpp:157, fntsys.cpp:709,1217, test_ripps2_text_port.py:72, tools/syntax_sweep.py:23. textshape.h:20-26 and textshape.cpp:283-287,332-376,436-440 show txtShape reorders lines holding txtRtlChar letters (Hebrew and Arabic ranges). INFERRED part: that txtShape's output is an acceptable replacement for the old extras-build bidi (not run on hardware).

findings.title: Kerning code in renderString/calcDimensionsLocked can never run: previous starts at 0 and is only assigned inside if (previous)
findings.problem: Each loop sets previous = 0 (755, 889, 1228) and the only assignment previous = glyph_index sits inside if (use_kerning && previous) (782, 843, 915, 1251), so the condition is always false: FT_Get_Kerning is never called and kerning is never applied. The blocks and the GlyphRun fields use_kerning, glyph_index, previous and delta are dead (inherited from upstream OPL).
findings.fix: Delete the kerning blocks, the use_kerning/previous setup and the unused GlyphRun fields (and delta_x in the __RTL body if finding 1 is not taken). Rendering is unchanged because the code never runs.
findings.benefit: ~35 lines removed (INFERRED from cited ranges); small code-size drop per loop, not measured.
findings.evidence: Read all four loops in fntsys.cpp (765-803, 827-848, 897-952, 1232-1255) and GlyphRun in fontsystem.h:93-100. Grep 'previous' in fntsys.cpp: only the = 0 initialisations and the assignments inside the if (... && previous) blocks.

findings.title: fntFitString duplicates fntWrapText's word wrap; theme text could use fntWrapText
findings.problem: Two word-wrap implementations live side by side: fntFitString (in place, used only by themeelems.cpp:282 and :579, where 579 already wraps a private copy) and fntWrapText (out of place, used by dia.cpp and guimodal.cpp, handles hard breaks, over-wide words and CJK/Thai/Lao). The theme path lacks the CJK handling the newer helper has.
findings.fix: Delete fntFitString and its prototype; at the two themeelems.cpp sites wrap with fntWrapText into a buffer sized for the inserted breaks (e.g. 2x the source length), keeping the existing private-copy ownership at 579. Update .github/scripts/test_font_fit_bounds.py.
findings.benefit: ~55 net lines removed (61-line function and 4-line prototype minus a few lines at the call sites); one wrap algorithm for all text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep fntFitString over the repo: definition fntsys.cpp:1135, prototype fntsys.h:68, callers themeelems.cpp:282 and :579, plus host test sources test_font_fit_bounds.py, test_list_cfg_text.py, test_theme_metadata.py. Grep fntWrapText callers: dia.cpp and guimodal.cpp (asserted in test_ripps2_text_port.py). Read themeelems.cpp:270-290 and 555-590.

findings.title: Cover-art lookup and frame-overlay drawing copied in grid.cpp, psbbnflow.cpp and coverflow.cpp
findings.problem: All three views resolve a cover texture the same way (getGameImageTexture, else the image's default texture, else COVER_DEFAULT, then a Mem check) and then draw it with the same block: if overlayTexture, rmDrawOverlayPixmap with all eight inlay corners scaled by drawn size over the cover element's size, then overlayTexture2; else rmDrawPixmap. About 12-14 matching lines per copy.
findings.fix: Move the lookup and the overlay-or-plain draw into one static helper in the theme layer (cover element, image, texture, x, y, w, h, colour, reflection) and call it from the three views.
findings.justification: The same 12-14 line block exists in three files; one helper of about 15 lines replaces about 40 lines, a net reduction.
findings.benefit: ~25 net lines removed (3 copies x ~13 lines minus a ~15-line helper), INFERRED; no measurable ELF change.
findings.evidence: Grep rmDrawOverlayPixmap( over src: grid.cpp:324, psbbnflow.cpp:169, coverflow.cpp:341 (all scale ov->*_x/_y by drawn/element size), themeelems.cpp:932,1308,1547 (unscaled, element geometry, not included). Read grid.cpp:288-336, psbbnflow.cpp:144-185, coverflow.cpp:283-347.

findings.title: Write-only font-system state: GSCLUT fields, glyph shy, and fntCacheFlushPage clearing pages that are freed next
findings.problem: GSCLUT is used only for FontSystem::clut_; its PSM, ClutPSM and VramClut are written in prepareCLUT and never read (newAtlas sets the surface's ClutPSM itself and reads only clut_.Clut). The glyph field shy is written at 631 and never read. fntCacheFlushPage clears every entry of a page that cacheFlush frees on the very next line, its only call site.
findings.fix: Replace GSCLUT clut_ with a plain u32 *clut_ and delete the GSCLUT typedef; delete the shy field and its store; delete fntCacheFlushPage and its call.
findings.benefit: ~22 lines removed (8-line typedef, 3 stores, shy, 11-line function and call), INFERRED; a few bytes of .bss and code.
findings.evidence: Grep GSCLUT|clut_.|shy|fntCacheFlushPage over all .c/.cpp/.h: GSCLUT only renderman.h:44 and fontsystem.h:122; clut_.PSM/ClutPSM/VramClut only the stores at fntsys.cpp:225,226,228; clut_.Clut read at 232,243,540; shy only fontsystem.h:51 and fntsys.cpp:631; fntCacheFlushPage only its definition and the call at 169 followed by free at 170.

findings.title: FontSystem class has a single static instance and the fnt* API is ten one-line forwarders to it
findings.problem: Only fntsys.cpp includes fontsystem.h; the one object is static FontSystem gFonts (1262), and fntInit, fntEnd, fntLoadFile, fntLoadFallback, fntLoadDefault, fntRelease, fntSetWeight, fntUpdateAspectRatio, fntRenderString and fntCalcDimensions only call the matching method. The class adds a public-method layer, copy-deletes and a constexpr constructor for an object nothing else can see.
findings.fix: Make the FontSystem members file-static state and the methods static functions in fntsys.cpp named as the public fnt* functions, deleting the forwarders and the public part of the class; keep fontsystem.h only if the private types are wanted in a header (or fold them into fntsys.cpp). Update test_cjk_font_fallback.py, which reads fontsystem.h.
findings.benefit: ~45 lines removed (forwarders and public declarations), INFERRED; no ELF change expected (calls are already direct after inlining or nearly so).
findings.evidence: Grep fontsystem.h over the repo: included only by fntsys.cpp:16 and read by .github/scripts/test_cjk_font_fallback.py:15. Grep FontSystem outside fntsys.cpp: only fontsystem.h. Read fntsys.cpp:1260-1324 and fontsystem.h:1-130.

findings.title: psbbnflow pageName and grid.cpp:482 re-implement menuItemGetText
findings.problem: Both compute text_id >= 0 ? _l(text_id) : text, which is menuItemGetText (menusys.cpp:1762). The comment at psbbnflow.cpp:187 says this avoids calling up into menusys, but the same theme layer already calls menuItemGetText (themeelems.cpp:1887).
findings.fix: Delete pageName and call menuItemGetText at psbbnflow.cpp:235,237,240 and grid.cpp:482.
findings.evidence: Grep 'text_id >= 0 ? _l(' over src: grid.cpp:482, psbbnflow.cpp:190, menusys.cpp:1798-1799 (sort compare). Grep menuItemGetText(: definition menusys.cpp:1762, caller themeelems.cpp:1887 in src/gfx.

findings.title: Commented-out code, dead log and stale TODO comments in fntsys.cpp
findings.problem: Four commented-out LOG lines, a commented-out 'should never happen' safeguard, a 'Face is NULL' log that then carries on to load the glyph anyway (FT_Load_Char fails on a NULL face and the error path logs again), a LOG with a stray argument (576), and old TODO/design notes (672, 683-691, 757-762) about rendering rework that never happened.
findings.fix: Delete the commented-out lines, the NULL-face log block, the stray LOG argument, and the stale TODO/notes comments.
findings.benefit: ~25 comment/dead lines removed; the NULL-face log string leaves .rodata (a few bytes, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read fntsys.cpp:545-638, 668-707, 742-763. The NULL check at 613 has no return; fntLoadGlyph (292-307) returns FT_Load_Char's error and cacheGlyph logs and returns NULL at 618-621.

findings.title: plasma: GCC<=3 asm branch, commented gradient list, history comment and forwarders
findings.problem: The #else branch of VU0MixVec is for GCC 3 register syntax; both supported toolchains (ps2build GCC and LLVM, which defines __GNUC__ 4) take the first branch. Lines 84-92 are commented-out pseudo-code, 231-240 is a change-history note ending in a needless alias (blend = blendColor), plasma.h:6 names a gone path (src/plasma.cpp), and ease() only forwards to the private smoothStep.
findings.fix: Delete the #if/#else/#endif and keep the modern asm; delete the commented gradient lines and the history note, use blendColor directly; fix the path in the comment; make smoothStep public as ease (or the reverse) and drop the forwarder.
findings.benefit: ~30 lines removed, INFERRED; no ELF change (the deleted asm branch is never compiled).
findings.evidence: Read plasma.cpp:1-260 and plasma.h:1-36. Grep .ease( over the repo: guiscreens.cpp:70,76 only; smoothStep used inside plasma.cpp:22,141-143. Brief section 2: builds are ps2build GCC and LLVM only.
